params.caption: 🖥️ JEDEC previews DDR6: smaller sticks, way more bandwidth The memory standards body JEDEC has given a first look at DDR6. Modules shrink from 133mm to 74mm long (about 44% smaller) while starting at 12.8 GT/s, more than double DDR5's baseline transfer rate, with up to 4x its baseline bandwidth. JEDEC also points to capacities of up to 1TB per slot. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 13:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 💾 Upgrading on day one or sticking with DDR5?
